population.description: Adults doing intense or frequent physical activity

gradeRationale.note: Source recommends magnesium requirements run 10-20% higher for people doing intense exercise vs. sedentary individuals - supports scaling a dosing target by activity_level, but the underlying soreness-outcome evidence itself is not strong enough to grade above Limited.

statement: People doing intense or frequent exercise have higher magnesium requirements than sedentary individuals, and closing that gap is associated with reduced muscle soreness; this is a requirements/adequacy argument more than a strong standalone ergogenic claim.

citations.title: Effects of magnesium supplementation on muscle soreness in different types of physical activities: systematic review

review.note: Drafted from master research list v2 (2026-09-05). Magnesium ingredient is standalone; dose ledger must be summed against magnesium already delivered by the multivitamin ingredient (see magnesium.json note).
